calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = false;

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint';

SELECT 
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint';

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) as distinct_sale_dates,
  MIN(f.sale_date) as first_sale_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) as last_sale_date,
  SUM(f.quantity) as total_units,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = true THEN f.sales_line_id END) as staff_purchase_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = false THEN f.sales_line_id END) as regular_sale_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period;
